title: Enablement cookbook & packaging for SDKs: streaming, structured output, and function-calling launch
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description:
Purpose: Produce a single enablement cookbook and packaging artifacts to coordinate launch messaging, release notes, sample apps, and SDK reference snippets for the streaming, structured output, and function-calling surfaces. This ticket bundles cross-functional orchestration work that unblocks docs, SDK releases (Python, Node, Go), Developer Relations sample kits, and support readiness.

Scope:
- Consolidate required release-note bullets and example snippets for each SDK and REST API.
- Produce a cookbook that contains canonical examples for: streaming partial responses, structured output (typed JSON + schema enforcement), and function-calling integrations (sync + streaming).
- Build three runnable sample apps (chat-streaming demo, structured-response form filler, webhook function-calling proxy).
- Coordinate QA tests, e2e smoke tests, and a quick rollback plan with Eng.
- Prepare a concise one-page launch brief for GTM, plus a packaging checklist for SDK maintainers.

Out-of-scope: deep rewrites of SDK API ergonomics and major design changes to the console UI. Those are tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Cookbook doc published in Confluence with examples for Python/Node/Go
Release-note snippets finalized and approved by PM + Docs + Legal
Three sample apps deployed to sample-apps.redwood.internal and linked in README
SDK packages (python, node, go) contain the new examples and are included in the release branch
E2E smoke tests covering streaming, structured output validation, and function calling pass on canary
Rollout runbook completed and reviewed by Reliability and Support

rollout_plan: Phase 0 (canary): 2026-03-22 - internal traffic only, run e2e smoke tests (0% public)

Phase 2 (ramped): 2026-03-27 - 10% traffic with automatic rollback thresholds: 5% increase in 95th pct latency or >2% absolute increase in error rate
Phase 3 (GA): 2026-03-30 - full rollout with deprecation note for legacy snippets if any
